title: Microsoft Stream: seek bar thumbnails for Teams meeting recordings
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned hover previews and overdue target, and the recording policy path and PowerShell command are documented. Searches confirmed the narrowly stated gaps in thumbnail controls, default behaviour and feature-specific licensing; the SharePoint reference mentioned in the prose should be added to the sources.

claims.claim: The meeting recording toggle is reached in Teams admin center through Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting recording.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select an existing policy or create a new one. Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowCloudRecording $true enables meeting recording for the selected policy.
claims.quote: To manage meeting recording by using PowerShell, use the -AllowCloudRecording parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowCloudRecording $true

claims.where: controls[1].governs and note; Scope: Prerequisites; Governance controls
claims.claim: The meeting recording policy allows or prevents the users it covers from recording meetings.
claims.quote: You can use the Microsoft Teams admin center or PowerShell to control whether your users can record meetings and events. Both the organizer and recording initiator need to have recording permissions to record the meeting or event.

claims.claim: AllowCloudRecording controls recording itself rather than switching playback thumbnails on or off.
claims.quote: -AllowCloudRecording controls whether users can record meetings; it doesn't configure or validate recording storage.

claims.claim: The planned thumbnail previews concern existing Teams meeting recording content.
claims.quote: The thumbnails provide a preview of the video content when hovering over the player's seek bar at a certain timestamp. Currently, it will only be made available for Teams meeting recordings.
